title: MB to GB Converter
metaDescription: Convert Megabytes (MB) to Gigabytes (GB) with both Decimal (SI 1000) and Binary (IEC 1024) calculations.
directAnswer: To convert Megabytes (MB) to Gigabytes (GB), divide by 1,000 using the decimal SI standard (1,000 MB = 1 GB), or divide by 1,024 using the binary IEC standard (1,024 MiB = 1 GiB). For example, 5,000 MB equals 5 GB in decimal, or approximately 4.88 GiB in binary.

faq.question: How many MB are in 1 GB?
faq.answer: In the decimal system (SI) used by disk makers and macOS, there are exactly 1,000 MB in 1 GB. In the binary system (IEC) used by Windows, there are 1,024 MiB in 1 GiB.

faq.question: What is 2048 MB in GB?
faq.answer: 2,048 MB in binary is exactly 2.0 GiB (or 2.048 GB in decimal).

faq.question: Why does Windows show less GB than my phone or Mac?
faq.answer: Windows divides by 1,024³ (binary GiB) while labeling it 'GB', whereas modern macOS and Android divide by 1,000³ (decimal GB).
